scope: Marked continuum references only. c=1, 6*pi*G=1, ts=1, comoving ball volume 1. Fixed protocol before numerical evaluation.
flux_gate: At highest two densities all geometry/cut/padding cells must have |M_BD/M-1|<=0.10 and |Q96-Q64|<=0.01; no refit. A failure is finite-domain only.
poisson_volume_gate: All simultaneous Garwood-based relative error intervals for corrected volume inside +/-8%; report intrinsic individual precision separately. Independent cells, shared count within nested windows.
poisson_mass_gate: For known density weight, compound-Poisson two-sided Bernstein error bound plus observed error must fit 8% relative across all cells. Reference mass not independently inferred.
